page.overview:
Who is Evelyn Wress?

() is the elven caretaker of Lord Ariks Eshteross at his estate in Jrusar. As an NPC, she is played by Matthew Mercer.

Evelyn is a middle-aged elven woman, with light auburn hair that is lighter near her temples. When first encountered by the group later named Bells Hells, she was wearing a shawl and a simple but well-made dress of black and silver.

Evelyn appears attentive to Lord Eshteross and understands intuitively (or from experience) what he wants from her at any given moment. When Bertrand Bell and the newly gathered party arrived unexpectedly, she obtained permission from Lord Eshteross to admit them, escorted them to his room, then left at his nod, locking the door behind her.

Lord Eshteross met Evelyn after he retired from his mercenary career.
